claim: Amazon RDS automatically enables Amazon RDS Extended Support when Aurora MySQL and Aurora PostgreSQL major engine versions in your DB clusters and global clusters reach the Aurora end of standard support date; the document history lists this on February 15, 2024.
question: What happens to an Aurora major engine version when it reaches the end of standard support?

values.display: automatically enables Amazon RDS Extended Support

qualifiers.scope: Aurora MySQL and Aurora PostgreSQL major engine versions
qualifiers.condition: you can opt out to avoid charges

note: d27-098. Cost trap: this enrollment is billed.
